description: This PHP file defines classes related to configuration options for the AWS CRT library, providing mechanisms to handle various option values and retrieve them in different formats.

classes.name: OptionValue
classes.description: Encapsulates a value and provides methods to interpret it as different data types.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Manages a collection of options with methods to retrieve values in various formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for OptionValue and Options classes, initializing internal data.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an object.

methods.name: asMixed
methods.description: Returns the stored value as is.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts the stored value to an integer, returning 0 if empty.

methods.name: asBool
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a boolean.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a string, returning empty string if empty.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Converts the stored value to an array, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: asCallable
methods.description: Returns the value if it is callable, otherwise null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an OptionValue instance for the specified option name.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an option value as integer.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves an option value as string.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves an option value as boolean.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access options as properties.

methods.name: asArray (Options)
methods.description: Returns all options as an array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns a recursive array copy of the options.
